title: Supervisor de Treinamento
description:

Esse(a) profissional terá papel estratégico na preparação do time de vendas para atuar em um portfólio amplo, com processos complexos e alto impacto nos resultados do negócio.

Ambição brutal e foco em resultados.

title: Vendedor Externo (Gestor de Negócios)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Vendedor Externo (Gestor de Negócios) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

VENDEDOR EXTERNO (GESTOR DE NEGÓCIOS)


A Patrimonial Segurança é uma empresa especializada na proteção patrimonial, consolidada como referência no setor de segurança privada na região de Santa Catarina. Com uma trajetória marcada pela excelência e inovação, a empresa oferece soluções completas e personalizadas para atender às necessidades de segurança de seus clientes, sejam eles residenciais, comerciais ou industriais.

A atuação da Patrimonial Segurança é pautada em três pilares fundamentais:


· Tecnologia Avançada: Utilizando equipamentos modernos, sistemas de monitoramento eletrônico, alarmes e controle de acesso, a empresa garante um alto nível de eficiência no combate a incidentes.

· Equipe Altamente Capacitada: Os profissionais da Patrimonial Segurança passam por rigorosos processos de seleção, treinamento contínuo e atualizações, assegurando que estejam preparados para lidar com diferentes cenários e desafios de segurança.

· Atendimento Personalizado: Cada cliente recebe uma análise detalhada das necessidades de segurança, resultando em planos de ação específicos, capazes de prevenir riscos e proteger bens e pessoas de maneira eficaz.

A empresa se destaca por sua ética profissional, compromisso com a qualidade e foco na construção de relacionamentos de confiança com seus clientes.

Com presença sólida na região de Chapecó e Itajaí, a Patrimonial Segurança é mais do que uma prestadora de serviços; é uma parceira estratégica na proteção de bens e na promoção da tranquilidade.

Estamos em busca de um (a) Vendedor Externo (Gestor de Negócios (a) – Comercial PJ para integrar nosso time!


1. Objetivo da Função

Atuar na prospecção, venda e gestão de novos contratos, além de realizar o atendimento e manutenção da carteira ativa de clientes, garantindo resultados comerciais consistentes e alinhados às metas da empresa.


2. Responsabilidades Principais

A. Prospecção e Vendas

• Identificar e abordar novas oportunidades de negócio.

• Realizar apresentação de produtos/serviços da empresa.

• Elaborar propostas comerciais e conduzir negociação até o fechamento.

• Realizar visitas comerciais


B. Gestão da Carteira de Clientes

• Atender e acompanhar a base atual de clientes.

• Identificar oportunidades de expansão (upsell/cross-sell).

• Garantir a satisfação e a retenção dos contratos ativos.

• Acompanhar pós-venda e resolver demandas comerciais.


C. Operações Comerciais

• Cumprir metas mensais definidas para vendas novas e carteira.

• Registrar todas as atividades no CRM

• Participar de reuniões de alinhamento com a coordenação/comercial.


3. Requisitos Obrigatórios

• Experiência prévia em vendas consultivas e gestão de carteira.

• Conhecimento em negociação, relacionamento com clientes e rotinas comerciais.

• Organização, boa comunicação verbal e escrita.

• Capacidade de trabalhar com metas e indicadores.

• CNH B e disponibilidade para deslocamentos

• Escolaridade: Mínimo ensino médio completo (preferência ensino superior em andamento/completo – Administração, Comercial, Marketing ou áreas correlatas).


4. Competências Comportamentais

• Proatividade e autonomia.

• Capacidade de resolução de problemas.

• Boa postura comercial e perfil comunicativo.

• Organização e disciplina para gestão de agenda e funil de vendas.

• Trabalho em equipe e alinhamento com processos internos.

• Empatia e foco no cliente.


• Modalidade: PJ

• Remuneração: A combinar

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Electrical Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

You have built solid experience in high-voltage engineering and you are ready to take full technical ownership of primary system design on projects that sit at the heart of the energy transition. If working on complex HV infrastructure for a technically leading organisation in Europe interests you, this role is worth your full attention.


Company Information

Our client is a recognised leader in the design, implementation, and management of high-voltage systems in the Netherlands. With a strong focus on innovation and sustainable energy strategy, they work at the forefront of grid enhancement and energy transition projects across the sector. Their engineering teams bring deep technical expertise to primary HV systems and the civil and structural solutions required to support them. This is a technically driven organisation where quality, precision, and engineering integrity are central to everything they deliver.


Vacancy Information

As an Electrical Engineer, your focus sits firmly in the domain of high-voltage primary systems and the supporting structures required for the installation and mounting of HV components. This includes power transformers, circuit breakers, disconnectors, current and voltage instrument transformers, cable and overhead line connections, and all associated civil and structural support arrangements.

You will take full responsibility from basic design through detailed design and on to execution and project delivery. You will translate functional requirements into concrete technical solutions, prepare and review engineering documentation, and support the Lead Engineer and Technical Manager across all project phases. When design bottlenecks arise, you identify and resolve them. When quality checks are needed, you perform them.

This is a hands-on engineering role with real ownership and direct involvement from the earliest design stages through to final delivery.


Key Responsibilities

  • Translating functional designs and client requirements into concrete technical designs and project plans for HV primary systems.
  • Designing and verifying integrated solutions based on client specifications, applicable technical standards including IEC and ABNT, and relevant laws and regulations.
  • Preparing and reviewing technical documentation, engineering drawings, calculations, and execution documents across all project phases.
  • Supporting the Lead Engineer and Technical Manager from basic design in the preparation phase through to detailed execution design.
  • Identifying and resolving design bottlenecks, reporting findings to the wider project team, and performing quality checks on deliverables.
  • Working closely with civil, structural, and electrical disciplines to ensure that primary component installations are fully integrated and constructible.


What You Need

  • Bachelor degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Power Engineering, or a comparable technical field.
  • Solid experience in high-voltage primary system design, with working knowledge of HV components such as power transformers, circuit breakers, disconnectors, and instrument transformers including CTs and VTs.
  • Familiarity with HV substation layouts, overhead line connections, cable termination arrangements, and supporting civil and structural requirements.
  • Understanding of applicable technical standards and design codes relevant to high-voltage systems including IEC standards. Familiarity with ABNT NBR requirements is considered an advantage.
  • Strong analytical thinking with the ability to develop and verify integrated technical solutions under project conditions.
  • A proactive and results-oriented mindset with the drive to deliver quality outcomes for both the project and your own professional development.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary engineering team.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Willingness to learn Dutch and integrate into a Dutch working environment is expected and will be an important part of settling into the team successfully.


If you do not meet every requirement but have a strong background in high-voltage engineering and a genuine interest in primary system design, we still encourage you to apply. The right combination of technical experience, motivation, and willingness to grow can make you a strong candidate.


Relocation

This position is based in the Netherlands and will require relocation. We understand that making an international move is a significant decision and we are here to make that process as straightforward as possible.

As part of your contract, FairPlay Engineering provides a Premium Relocation Package. This includes visa sponsorship, guidance before your move, and dedicated support from a relocation consultant throughout the process. You can find more information on the Relocating with us page on our website.


Apply

We appreciate every application we receive. Because this is a specialised role, we will contact candidates whose experience closely matches the requirements.

If you have not heard from us within two weeks, your application has unfortunately not been selected for the next step.


FairPlay Engineering specialises in recruiting engineers for roles in the Netherlands. If this vacancy is not the right match for you, keep an eye on our vacancies page for future opportunities.

title: Senior Creative Director
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Creative Director em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Creative Director

Talent Global LLC — Remote

Part-Time (10 hrs/week) | US Time Zones | Long-Term Contract


About the Role

Our client is a US-based performance marketing agency that builds and scales creative content for brands across paid social and digital channels. They are looking for a Creative Director to serve as the internal quality gate for all creative output — both video and graphics — before it reaches the client. This person will work closely with the agency's leadership team, taking ownership of creative review, direction, and strategy across active accounts.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review and QA all video and graphic creative assets before client delivery, ensuring quality, brand alignment, and strategic clarity
  • Provide clear, actionable creative direction to designers and video editors based on client briefs and performance goals
  • Develop creative strategies for new content batches — defining concept, visual direction, messaging angle, and format
  • Identify creative weaknesses across active accounts and propose improvements proactively
  • Maintain a high creative bar across all output, with strong attention to detail in both visual execution and storytelling


Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Creative Director, Senior Art Director, or equivalent role at a marketing agency or performance-focused creative team
  • Strong portfolio spanning both video and graphic content — social ads, brand content, or performance creative
  • Ability to both review/direct existing work and develop new creative strategies from scratch
  • Deep understanding of what makes creative perform on paid social channels (Meta, TikTok, YouTube)
  • Experience working with or managing designers and video editors
  • Excellent written and verbal English — able to communicate creative feedback clearly and professionally
  • Self-directed and highly detail-oriented — comfortable working async with a lean team
  • Familiarity with AI creative tools (Midjourney, Runway, or similar) is a plus


Ideal Candidate

This role is for someone who has a natural eye for what's working and what isn't — and can articulate why with precision. They thrive in fast-moving agency environments where standards are high and feedback cycles are tight. They are equally comfortable directing a video edit and reviewing a static ad set, and they understand that creative strategy and execution are inseparable. They don't need to be reminded to raise the bar — they set it.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Java | Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Desenvolvedora Java | Sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO :


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções técnicas de média e alta complexidade, com boa autonomia, utilizando as tecnologias, frameworks e padrões adotados nos projetos da BU de Core Banking.
  • Analisar, compreender e evoluir a arquitetura das aplicações, avaliando componentes, integrações, estrutura, segurança e regras de negócio envolvidas.
  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir funcionalidades com foco em qualidade, desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade e aderência às necessidades do negócio.
  • Criar, manter e apoiar a evolução de testes manuais e automatizados, contribuindo para a confiabilidade das entregas e para a cobertura dos requisitos funcionais e técnicos.

  • Documentar implementações, fluxos, decisões técnicas e etapas do desenvolvimento, utilizando ferramentas de versionamento, rastreabilidade e documentação técnica.
  • Realizar detalhamento técnico de demandas em conjunto com clientes, analistas de negócio e demais áreas envolvidas, transformando requisitos funcionais em soluções viáveis, sustentáveis e aderentes à arquitetura definida.
  • Garantir a qualidade do software por meio da aplicação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento, revisão de código, padronização e uso adequado de frameworks, servidores de aplicação e ferramentas corporativas.
  • Atuar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, analistas, QA e áreas parceiras, promovendo alinhamento técnico e funcional ao longo do ciclo de desenvolvimento.
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas e funcionais com time e cliente, apoiando o esclarecimento de dúvidas, o refinamento de escopo e a evolução contínua das soluções.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:


  • Experiência em desenvolvimento Java (Java 8 e/ou 17).

  • Domínio de frameworks como Spring Boot, JAX-WS, JAX-RS, CDI, JPA, JEE, JSF, EJB e AngularJS e ferramentas de mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (SQL e Oracle).
  • Experiência com Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Git, Wildfly 11 e/ou 18 e práticas de CI/CD.
  • Familiaridade com APIs REST, GraphQL e integrações complexas.
  • Vivência com GIT e Maven (para build e gerenciamento de dependências)


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER :

  • Certificações Java ou em arquitetura de software.
  • Vivência em projetos de transformação digital e sistemas de grande escala.

Oi, somos a WEBMANIA! Uma empresa de tecnologia que simplifica e automatiza processos fiscais para milhares de empresas no Brasil. Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Atuar como interface técnica entre o cliente e as equipes internas (Desenvolvimento e Contabilidade), traduzindo demandas complexas para agilizar negociações e correções;

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando em Tecnologia, Sistemas de Informação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência anterior com implantação de sistemas (SaaS), onboarding de clientes ou suporte técnico B2B;
  • Familiaridade com APIs, integrações, leitura de documentações técnicas, JSONs, entre outros;
  • Habilidade para conduzir apresentações e demonstrações online de forma clara e didática;
  • Capacidade analítica e facilidade para resolução de problemas.


O que mais gostaríamos de ver:

  • Conhecimento básico sobre emissão de Notas Fiscais;
  • Familiaridade com CRM ou ERP para gestão de clientes;
  • Inglês técnico.


O que a WEBMANIA oferece:

  • 40 horas semanais (8 horas de segunda à sexta com pausa de 1 hora para almoço);

  • Seguro de vida;

Sobre o processo seletivo:

  • Triagem do currículo: a primeira etapa é uma triagem do currículo (normalmente ocorre dentro de 7 dias após a candidatura).
  • Entrevista com RH: a segunda etapa é uma entrevista por videochamada com o nosso RH, com duração de aproximadamente 15 minutos.
  • Realização de testes: a terceira etapa consiste na realização de testes comportamentais, de raciocínio lógico e avaliação técnica.
  • Entrevista Técnica: a quarta e última etapa será uma entrevista em vídeo, tanto com o RH quanto com seu futuro supervisor, com duração de aproximadamente 30 minutos.

title: AI Creative Director
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Creative Director em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: AI Visual Storytelling Designer/AI Creative Producer


About the Role

Our client company (a US-based Creative Agency) is looking for 2–3 highly creative AI-native talents who can combine generative AI, motion design, video editing, and visual storytelling to create modern, high-performing social content for brands and ventures.


This is not a traditional graphic design or video editing role. We are looking for creatives who deeply understand internet aesthetics, AI-powered workflows, cinematic social visuals, and short-form content that captures attention immediately.


You will work across AI-generated imagery, motion graphics, editing, creative direction, and experimental visual concepts to produce premium content similar to the examples below:

  • Fast-paced visual storytelling
  • AI-generated cinematic visuals
  • Social-first brand content
  • Stylized motion design
  • Creative AI advertising assets
  • Premium/High-end startup and venture-style aesthetics


Responsibilities

  • Create visually compelling AI-powered social content for Instagram and paid ads
  • Produce short-form videos using AI-generated visuals, motion graphics, editing, and sound design
  • Develop creative concepts and visual storytelling ideas from briefs or creative direction
  • Use generative AI tools to create unique imagery, animations, environments, and visual sequences
  • Edit high-quality content with strong pacing, transitions, typography, and cinematic composition
  • Stay up to date with AI creative trends, social content trends, and emerging tools
  • Maintain strong brand aesthetics and visual consistency across projects
  • Iterate quickly and efficiently in a fast-paced startup environment


Ideal Candidate

  • Strong portfolio showcasing AI-generated visuals, motion graphics, or cinematic social content
  • Experience creating modern social-first creative content for startups, agencies, brands, or creators
  • Strong understanding of visual storytelling, pacing, composition, typography, and internet culture
  • Ability to combine creativity with execution speed
  • Self-directed, proactive, and highly collaborative
  • Strong aesthetic taste and attention to detail
  • Comfortable experimenting with new creative workflows and AI tools


Preferred Tools & Skills

Experience with several of the following:

  • Runway
  • Midjourney
  • CapCut
  • Kling AI
  • Sora
  • Pika
  • Generative AI workflows
  • Motion graphics and animation
  • Short-form content editing
  • Creative direction
  • Storyboarding and concept development
  • Sound design and pacing
  • Brand storytelling


Nice to Have

  • Experience creating paid social creatives or performance marketing content
  • Understanding of viral short-form content frameworks
  • Experience with 3D or experimental visual workflows
  • Familiarity with creative automation workflows

title: Assistente em Produção de Eventos Corporativos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Assistente em Produção de Eventos Corporativos em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Há mais de 33 anos e milhares de eventos realizados, a C&L produz feiras, congressos e eventos corporativos para algumas das principais marcas do país, com forte atuação no agronegócio. Trabalhamos do planejamento à execução em campo.


Procuramos um(a) assistente de produção que funcione bem sob ritmo acelerado, organize o caos de um evento presencial e resolva problema na hora em que ele aparece, não depois. Se você gosta de ver um projeto sair do cronograma e virar realidade, é com você que queremos falar.


Local: presencial, Vila Ester, Zona Norte de São Paulo.

Horário: segunda a sexta, 8h30 às 18h.

Contratação: CLT ou PJ, conforme o perfil.


O que você vai fazer

  • Gestão de fornecedores: logística, alimentação, gráfica, limpeza e estrutura, da contratação ao acompanhamento durante o evento.
  • Apoio em orçamentos e na captação de novos fornecedores, com foco em custo-benefício.
  • Criação e controle de cronogramas detalhados, garantindo prazo.
  • Organização de reuniões e briefings, internos e externos.
  • Produção e operação dos eventos, incluindo cenografia e materiais promocionais.
  • Controle de materiais e brindes.
  • Credenciamento e RSVP.
  • Atendimento a clientes e participantes durante os eventos.
  • Relatórios pós-evento.


O que esperamos de você

  • Graduação completa ou em andamento em Eventos, Turismo, Administração, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Organização, atenção a detalhe e proatividade.
  • Boa comunicação e jogo de cintura para resolver imprevisto.
  • Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) e Teams em nível intermediário ou avançado.
  • Morar em São Paulo.


Conta pontos

  • Disponibilidade para viagens nacionais.
  • Experiência prévia com eventos corporativos, feiras e congressos.
  • Vivência em gestão de fornecedores e compras.


Benefícios

CLT: salário a combinar, com crescimento por desempenho. Vale-transporte (Flash), almoço no refeitório da empresa, férias remuneradas e 13º.


PJ: remuneração de mercado. Auxílio deslocamento, almoço no refeitório, pausa remunerada equivalente a férias e bônus anual equivalente ao 13º.

title: Veterinarian
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Veterinarian em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Veterinary Analyst (PJ Contractor)


Join SignalPET as a Junior Veterinary Analyst and Shape the Future of Veterinary Radiology!


At SignalPET, we’re transforming the veterinary industry with cutting-edge radiograph interpretation technology. Our mission? To elevate veterinary care through advanced, accessible, and highly accurate radiographic insights. Committed to innovation and excellence, we’re making a meaningful impact on the veterinary profession worldwide.


As we rapidly expand, we’re excited to invite Junior Veterinary Analysts who are driven, qualified, and passionate about companion animal radiology to join our dynamic team.

Why SignalPET?


Innovative Environment: Be part of a pioneering tech company in its hyper-growth stage.

Career Advancement: Grow with us while advancing your expertise in veterinary radiology.

Work-Life Balance: Enjoy a flexible remote working environment with competitive compensation.

Impactful Work: Make a difference by assisting in the development of AI technology that’s shaping the future of veterinary care.


What We’re Looking For:

  • A qualified Médico Veterinário.
  • Clinical experience (an advantage), with a strong interest in radiology.
  • A Brazilian citizen or holder of a valid Brazilian work permit.
  • Ability to work as an independent contractor (PJ).


Role & Responsibilities:

  • Screen routine radiographic studies.
  • Assist in the development and improvement of our AI technology.


What You’ll Bring:

  • Sharp analytical skills and meticulous attention to detail.
  • A disciplined, motivated, and ethical approach to work.
  • Strong time management skills and the ability to follow detailed instructions.


Shift Details:

We have 2 positions available and the shifts are as follows:


Monday to Sunday, from 2:00 PM to 12:00 AM São Paulo time, one week on and one week off.


Example Schedule:

  • Week 1: Monday to Sunday ON
  • Week 2: Monday to Sunday OFF
  • Week 3: Monday to Sunday ON
  • Week 4: Monday to Sunday OFF

Independent Contractor (PJ – Pessoa Jurídica)

Location:

Remote


Training:

Full training provided.


Excited to Elevate Your Career with SignalPET?

Apply today to join a team where your work directly contributes to the advancement of veterinary science and technology.


Please provide your resume in English, if possible.

title: Subject Matter Expert - Banking
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Subject Matter Expert - Banking em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview

We’re hiring banking and fintech professionals with hands-on experience across Chase, PayPal, Venmo, and Mint to evaluate AI systems handling payments, disputes, fraud, and personal finance scenarios.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Create banking and payments workflow prompts
  • Build synthetic transaction, dispute, and reconciliation scenarios
  • Evaluate AI responses for accuracy and compliance
  • Identify issues like failed transfers, fraud false positives, and sync failures


Requirements

  • 4–9+ years in banking, fintech, fraud ops, merchant payments, or personal finance
  • Experience with Chase, PayPal, Venmo, Mint, or related platforms
  • Understanding of consumer banking regulations (Reg E, Reg Z, AML/KYC)
  • Strong analytical and written communication skills
  • Comfort using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude


Nice to have

  • Experience with Stripe, Square, Cash App, Plaid, or Robinhood
  • AI evaluation or RLHF experience
  • Knowledge of fintech integrations and data aggregation


Perks of Freelancing With Turing

  • Work in a fully remote environment.


Offer Details

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week)

title: SDR - Pré Vendas B2B SAAS
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SDR - Pré Vendas B2B SAAS em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Sobre a Orbit

A Orbit Gestão é uma plataforma de gestão empresarial com Agentes de IA integrados que ajudam empresas a organizar processos, pessoas, indicadores e resultados.

Em poucos meses de operação, já somos utilizados por milhares de empresas e estamos crescendo rapidamente. Nosso objetivo é transformar a forma como pequenas e médias empresas fazem gestão utilizando Inteligência Artificial.

Buscamos pessoas com energia, ambição e vontade de crescer para fazer parte dessa jornada.

O que você fará

Como SDR, sua missão será identificar oportunidades de negócio e gerar reuniões qualificadas para o time comercial.

Você será responsável por:

  • Entrar em contato com leads gerados pelo marketing.
  • Qualificar empresas através de diagnóstico consultivo.
  • Identificar dores de gestão, processos, pessoas e crescimento.
  • Agendar demonstrações para os Executivos de Vendas.
  • Realizar follow-ups estratégicos.
  • Atualizar informações no CRM.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com marketing e vendas para otimizar conversões.
  • Atingir metas de reuniões qualificadas e oportunidades geradas.
Perfil que buscamos

Você provavelmente terá sucesso nessa posição se:

  • Gosta de conversar com pessoas.
  • Tem facilidade para criar conexão e gerar confiança.
  • É organizado e disciplinado.
  • Possui boa comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • É movido por metas e resultados.
  • Aprende rápido e gosta de tecnologia.
  • Tem interesse por Inteligência Artificial, SaaS e gestão empresarial.
RequisitosObrigatórios
  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Boa comunicação.
  • Conhecimento básico de CRM.
  • Familiaridade com WhatsApp, e-mail e LinkedIn.
  • Organização e disciplina para seguir processos.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência anterior como SDR, BDR ou Inside Sales.
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas.
  • Conhecimento em SaaS.
  • Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial.
  • Experiência com HubSpot, Pipedrive ou RD Station.
O que oferecemos
  • Salário fixo compatível com o mercado.
  • Comissão por meta atingida.
  • Plano de crescimento estruturado.
  • Treinamento em vendas, IA e gestão empresarial.
  • Contato direto com uma das startups SaaS que mais cresce no segmento.
  • Ambiente meritocrático e focado em performance.
Metas da posição

O SDR será avaliado por indicadores como:

  • Leads contatados.
  • Taxa de conexão.
  • Taxa de qualificação.
  • Reuniões realizadas.
  • Oportunidades geradas.
  • Receita influenciada.
Modelo de trabalho
  • Presencial em Florianópolis/SC.
  • Horário comercial.
  • Contratação PJ.
Quem não se encaixa

Esta vaga não é para quem:

  • Busca apenas estabilidade.
  • Não gosta de falar com clientes.
  • Tem dificuldade em trabalhar com metas.
  • Precisa de supervisão constante.
  • Não gosta de tecnologia ou Inteligência Artificial.
Quem se destaca na Orbit

Pessoas que enxergam essa posição não apenas como um emprego, mas como uma oportunidade de construir carreira em uma empresa de tecnologia em forte crescimento.

title: Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Azure DevOps Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Title: Senior Azure DevOps Engineer

Duration: 6+ Months

Location: 40% Remote and 60% onsite in São Paulo, Brazil (Paraiso district) - onsite 1 week every 2-3 weeks


Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and creative Senior Azure DevOps Engineer to provide technical leadership and drive the evolution of our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines. In this role, you will not only manage progress on critical projects and provide high-level support, but you will also serve as the technical anchor for our DevOps practices.

The ideal candidate blends deep technical proficiency in the Microsoft Azure ecosystem with the creative problem-solving skills required to build elegant, scalable, and secure automation frameworks.


Key Responsibilities & Deliverables

  • Technical Leadership: Serve as the subject matter expert on Azure DevOps practices, guiding project architecture and mentoring team members without the burden of administrative people-management.
  • Project Delivery & Support: Ensure steady, measurable progress on core engineering projects while providing robust tier-3 infrastructure and pipeline support.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Design, build, and maintain modular, multi-environment (Dev/Test/Prod) infrastructure using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates, ensuring strict adherence to state and drift management best practices.
  • CI/CD Automation: Design and optimize sophisticated, multi-stage YAML-based Azure DevOps pipelines to automate infrastructure and application deployments for multi-language stacks (.NET, Python, Node.js, Java).
  • DevSecOps Implementation: Integrate robust security gates, vulnerability scanners, and compliance checks directly into the CI/CD lifecycle.


Azure Platform Expertise

  • IaC Tools: Proven experience with Terraform (utilizing remote state on Azure Storage), Bicep, or ARM.
  • Azure DevOps Services: Deep familiarity with the full ADO suite (Repos, Pipelines, Boards, Artifacts).
  • Scripting & Management: Proficiency with Azure CLI, PowerShell (Az module), and REST APIs.
  • Observability: Hands-on experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
  • Governance & Security: Strong grasp of Azure Policy, Blueprints, RBAC, and Azure Key Vault for secret/certificate management.
  • Containers & Serverless: Foundational knowledge of Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Helm, Azure Container Registry (ACR), Azure Functions, and App Services.

CI/CD & Deployment Strategies

  • Mastery of multi-stage YAML pipelines in Azure DevOps (GitHub Actions is a strong plus).
  • Proven track record implementing advanced deployment strategies (Blue-Green, Canary, Rolling).
  • Experience integrating security scanning tools such as SonarQube, WhiteSource, or Snyk into automated pipelines.

Security & Enterprise Compliance

  • Comprehensive understanding of Secure DevOps practices and automated security gates (SCA, IaC scans).
  • Experience with Azure Active Directory (AAD) integration and MFA policies.
  • Familiarity with Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, and enterprise security baselines is highly desirable.

What Will Make You Successful

  • Technical Proficiency: You have a battle-tested understanding of enterprise Azure environments and CI/CD mechanics. You don't just use tools; you know how they work under the hood.
  • Creativity: You look beyond standard templates to find innovative ways to optimize workflows, solve complex deployment bottlenecks, and design elegant technical solutions.
  • Drive for Progress: You are self-motivated to push projects across the finish line while maintaining high-quality support standards.

Grupo Smart Fit, a força que ativa o seu potencial.

O Grupo Smart Fit é a maior plataforma de fitness e bem-estar da América Latina e um dos grupos que mais crescem no mundo. Com atuação em mais de 16 países, mais de 2.000 unidades, mais de 23 mil colaboradores e um ecossistema completo de marcas, impactamos milhões de pessoas todos os dias por meio de experiências que promovem saúde, movimento e qualidade de vida.

  • Gestão de fornecedores: atuar no relacionamento com lawtechs, escritórios de advocacia parceiros e prestadores de tecnologia.

Quem somos nós: Ajudamos médicos e parceiros a ampliarem seus negócios, oferecendo tecnologias diferenciadas e de alto padrão de uso do mercado nacional e internacional. Há 30 anos, comercializamos as melhores tecnologias de equipamentos médicos para clínicas e hospitais atendendo áreas de dermato, cirurgia, ultrassom e outras da saúde. Somos a Skintec!



Estamos expandindo nosso time, venha trabalhar conosco:

  • Apoiar o processo de folha de pagamento junto ao BPO, realizando o envio de informações para fechamento, conferência de cálculos, validação de lançamentos e liberação para pagamento;

  • Realizar processos admissionais, alterações contratuais, movimentações internas, férias, afastamentos, retornos ao trabalho e rescisões;

  • Realizar atendimento aos colaboradores para esclarecimento de dúvidas relacionadas a folha, benefícios, ponto, férias e demais temas de Departamento Pessoal;
  • Manter atualizadas as bases de dados, controles internos, e arquivos funcionais dos colaboradores;
  • Garantir a organização, atualização e disponibilidade da documentação trabalhista para consultas internas, auditorias e fiscalizações;
  • Apoiar as rotinas de Medicina e Segurança do Trabalho, acompanhando exames admissionais, periódicos, retornos ao trabalho, mudanças de função e desligamentos;
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos da área, apoiando a implementação de controles, procedimentos e iniciativas que promovam maior eficiência operacional;
  • Apoiar as demais demandas administrativas do RH, contribuindo para o bom funcionamento da área e atendimento aos colaboradores e gestores.



Qualificações

  • Experiência prévia em rotinas de Departamento Pessoal;
  • Conhecimento em legislação trabalhista;

title: SDR JR
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SDR JR em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a WAS

A WAS é um estúdio criativo especializado em branding, audiovisual e social media. Não somos uma agência comum, somos parceiros estratégicos de marcas que entendem que comunicação de alto nível é um diferencial competitivo, não um custo.

Em três anos, construímos uma carteira sólida de clientes de diferentes segmentos com um denominador comum: todos querem crescer e sabem que imagem importa. A gente entrega isso com excelência, do conceito à execução.


Sobre a vaga

Não estamos procurando alguém que gosta de vendas. Estamos procurando alguém que é obcecado por prospecção.

Que sente prazer em ligar, em escrever, em abordar. Que não aceita silêncio como resposta. Que acorda pensando em como vai bater a meta da semana.

Você vai operar em três frentes simultâneas: leads inbound via tráfego pago, contatos de redes sociais e prospecção ativa de médias empresas. O objetivo é sempre o mesmo — reunião marcada com decisor.



Responsabilidades

· Construir e qualificar listas com ICP definido e segmentação inteligente

· Identificar e acessar decisores — C-level, lideranças de marketing, gerência

· Executar cadências multicanal: cold call, email e redes sociais com consistência

· Qualificar leads inbound e outbound e agendar reuniões para o time de especialistas

· Manter o CRM organizado e atualizado no Pipedrive sem lacunas

· Trabalhar metas semanais de volume e conversão

· Colaborar com o time de marketing para afinar abordagem e melhorar conversão



Requisitos

· Mínimo de 18 meses de experiência comprovada como SDR ou BDR

· Histórico real em prospecção outbound — ligações, listas, cadências

· Alta dominância: assertividade, foco em resultado e zero enrolação

· Alta influência: comunicação que persuade sem pressionar

· Energia, proatividade e resiliência que aparecem nos números, não só no discurso

· Boa escuta e raciocínio rápido para qualificar e contornar objeções na hora



Diferenciais

· Experiência em agência de marketing ou comunicação

· Conhecimento em branding, tráfego pago ou geração de leads

· Experiência com Pipedrive

· Vivência com vendas consultivas

· Domínio de ICP e funil de vendas



O que oferecemos

· Remuneração: R$2.500 fixo PJ + variável atrelado a metas de reuniões marcadas, sem teto

· Modelo 100% remoto

· Ambiente direto, sem burocracia, onde performance fala mais alto que tempo de casa



O requisito que não negocia

Obsessão por prospecção.

O resto a gente constrói junto.

title: Culture & Learning Senior Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Culture & Learning Senior Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role


We're looking for a Culture & Learning Senior Manager to join our People & Organization team. In this role, you'll be a key driver of how we grow our people and shape the way we work together — building learning ecosystems and culture programs that scale with a fast-moving organization. This is a high-impact, hands-on role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, moves fast, and knows how to turn ideas into programs that actually stick.


What You'll Do

  • Champion and evolve our organizational culture, ensuring it remains a competitive advantage as the company grows
  • Design and lead initiatives that reinforce our values in day-to-day work — from onboarding to team rituals and beyond
  • Partner with leadership and cross-functional teams to embed cultural practices across all levels of the organization
  • Measure culture health and continuously iterate based on feedback and data
  • Build and manage end-to-end learning journeys for key talent segments (new hires, individual contributors, managers, leaders)
  • Identify capability gaps and design scalable programs — whether in-person, digital, or blended
  • Act as a strategic thought partner to HR Business Partners and senior leaders on people development topics
  • Manage budgets, timelines, and vendors with a results-oriented mindset
  • Build buy-in for culture and learning initiatives across a diverse, often distributed workforce


What We're Looking for

  • 10+ years of experience in L&D, organizational culture, or talent development
  • Proven track record in fast-paced, high-growth environments — internet, tech, or similarly dynamic industries strongly preferred
  • Experience designing and scaling learning programs from scratch, not just inheriting and maintaining
  • Strong facilitation and communication skills — you're as comfortable in a workshop as in a C-suite conversation
  • Data-driven mindset: you measure what matters and use it to improve
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and operate independently with minimal structure
  • Experience working across cultures or in multinational environments is a plus
  • Fluency in English required; additional languages


What Makes You Stand Out

  • You've built something from 0 to 1 — a program, a culture initiative, an L&D function
  • You understand that culture isn't a campaign — it's behavior, reinforce
  • You're energized by change, not slowed down by it.

title: Professor(a) de Artes Visuais
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor(a) de Artes Visuais em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position: Visual Arts Teacher

Section: Early Childhood Education (ECE) and Elementary School

Application Deadline: June 12, 2026

Start Date: July 15, 2026


Main responsibilities: Plan, deliver, and develop Visual Arts lessons for Early Childhood and Elementary students, aligned with BNCC, the IB PYP framework, and the school’s pedagogical approach. Promote inquiry-based, creative, and student-centered learning experiences that foster curiosity, imagination, and artistic expression. Design developmentally appropriate learning experiences, exploring a variety of media and techniques such as drawing, painting, collage, and sculpture, encouraging exploration, experimentation, and the development of artistic skills. Support students’ holistic development by fostering cognitive, social, emotional, and creative competencies, while encouraging growing autonomy, reflection, and a sense of identity. Ensure a safe, inclusive, and welcoming learning environment that supports student well-being and confidence to take creative risks. Use formative and observational assessment strategies to monitor and document student progress. Differentiate instruction to meet diverse learning needs in collaboration with the learning support team. Actively contribute to the development of the Arts program through curriculum planning, interdisciplinary projects, exhibitions, and school events, while maintaining effective communication with families.


Requirements: Teaching degree (Licenciatura) in Visual Arts. Fluency in English (Portuguese is desirable). Teaching experience, preferably in bilingual or international settings. Ability to work effectively with students from diverse cultural backgrounds. Strong communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills. Familiarity with educational technology tools and platforms. A Master's degree and IB PYP experience are considered desirable.


About the Company: School of the Nations is an international, nonprofit K-12 school inspired by the Bahá’í teachings, School of the Nations was founded with the primary purpose of unlocking human potential through academic excellence, the cultivation of moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service for the betterment of society. School of the Nations is an authorized International Baccalaureate (IB) School offering the Primary Years (PYP) and the Diploma (DP) Programs. Accredited as an international school by NEASC, our strategic development is guided by the ACE Learning Ecosystem 2.0.


Shared Understanding of High-Quality Learning

High-quality learning at the School of the Nations is rooted in our aspiration to release human potential through academic excellence, moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service, empowering learners to develop the capacities of heart and mind to understand the world and contribute to the betterment of society.


In an inclusive, diverse, and globally-minded community, our students develop cognitive, creative, physical, spiritual, and social-emotional abilities; learners are agents of their own learning, actively setting goals, engaging in rich and complex challenges, and documenting growth; they demonstrate depth of understanding, collaboration, reflection, and multiple perspectives across disciplines.


Learning happens through a coherent, inquiry-based curriculum grounded in spiritual principles and practical applications, with diverse assessment and feedback guiding meaningful growth.


School of the Nations is an equal-opportunity employer. We encourage people with disability to apply.


Cargo: Professor(a) de Artes Visuais

Segmento: Educação Infantil e Ensino Fundamental I

Prazo de Inscrição: 12 de junho de 2026

Data de início: 15 de julho de 2026


Principais responsabilidades: Planejar, ministrar e desenvolver aulas de Artes Visuais para estudantes da Educação Infantil e do Ensino Fundamental I, alinhadas à BNCC, ao PYP (IB) e ao projeto pedagógico da escola. Promover experiências de aprendizagem investigativas, criativas e centradas no aluno, que estimulem a curiosidade, a imaginação e a expressão artística. Elaborar experiências de aprendizagem adequadas ao desenvolvimento das crianças, explorando diferentes mídias e técnicas, como desenho, pintura, colagem, e escultura, incentivando a exploração, a experimentação e a construção de habilidades artísticas. Apoiar o desenvolvimento integral dos estudantes, promovendo competências cognitivas, sociais, emocionais e criativas, além de incentivar a autonomia progressiva, a reflexão e o senso de identidade. Garantir um ambiente seguro, inclusivo e acolhedor, que favoreça o bem-estar e a confiança dos alunos para assumir riscos criativos. Utilizar estratégias de avaliação formativa e observacional, com registro do progresso dos estudantes. Diferenciar o ensino para atender a diferentes perfis de aprendizagem em colaboração com a equipe de suporte à aprendizagem. Colaborar ativamente no desenvolvimento do programa de Artes, participando do planejamento curricular, projetos interdisciplinares, exposições e eventos escolares, além de manter comunicação eficaz com as famílias.


Requisitos: Licenciatura em Artes Visuais. Fluência em inglês (português desejável). Experiência docente, preferencialmente em contextos bilíngues ou internacionais. Capacidade de atuar de forma eficaz com estudantes de diferentes contextos culturais. Habilidades de comunicação, resolução de problemas e organização. Mestrado e experiência com o IB PYP serão diferenciais.


Sobre a empresa: A Escola das Nações é uma instituição internacional, privada, sem fins lucrativos, coeducacional e duolinguística (inglês e português), localizada em Brasília. Oferecemos um programa educacional que vai do berçário ao 12º ano e somos credenciados internacionalmente pela NEASC e, nacionalmente, pela Secretaria de Educação do Distrito Federal. Com estudantes e colaboradores de 30 países e origens diversas, promovemos um ambiente de aprendizado inclusivo que incentiva a cidadania global e valoriza a diversidade.


Compreensão Compartilhada de Aprendizagem de Alta Qualidade

A aprendizagem de alta qualidade na Escola das Nações está enraizada em nossa aspiração de liberar o potencial humano por meio da excelência acadêmica, do desenvolvimento de qualidades morais e espirituais e de um compromisso contínuo com o serviço, capacitando os alunos a desenvolverem as capacidades do coração e da mente para compreender o mundo e contribuir para o aprimoramento da sociedade.


Em uma comunidade inclusiva, diversa e com visão global, nossos estudantes desenvolvem habilidades cognitivas, criativas, físicas, espirituais e socioemocionais; os alunos são agentes do próprio aprendizado, definindo metas ativamente, engajando-se em desafios ricos e complexos e documentando seu crescimento; demonstram profundidade de compreensão, colaboração, reflexão e a capacidade de considerar múltiplas perspectivas entre as diferentes áreas do conhecimento.


A aprendizagem acontece por meio de um currículo coerente e baseado na investigação, fundamentado em princípios espirituais e aplicações práticas, com avaliações diversificadas e feedback que orientam um desenvolvimento significativo.


A Escola das Nações é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Incentivamos pessoas com deficiência a se candidatarem.

title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Todo Cartões

Todo Cartões is a company focused on delivering innovative and accessible financial solutions that simplify everyday transactions for individuals and businesses. Our mission is to create efficient, customer-centric products that combine technology, reliability, and ease of use, enabling better financial experiences across all touchpoints. We operate in a fast-paced environment that values collaboration, continuous improvement, and a strong commitment to results.


Overview

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Project Manager to lead and execute high-impact initiatives within our organization. This role is responsible for managing projects end-to-end, from planning and alignment to execution and delivery, ensuring timelines, scope, and objectives are met while delivering value to both customers and the business


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead project planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery across multiple initiatives.
  • Define project scope, goals, timelines, and deliverables in alignment with business objectives.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, marketing, and operations, to ensure successful project execution.
  • Identify risks, dependencies, and blockers, proactively managing mitigation plans.
  • Facilitate clear communication between stakeholders, ensuring alignment and visibility throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Manage project documentation, timelines, and status updates.
  • Track project performance using KPIs and ensure continuous improvement based on data and feedback.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with high quality standards.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in project management or related roles.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience managing cross-functional projects in fast-paced environments.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing requirements.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in technology, fintech, SaaS, or digital products.
  • Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Trello, Confluence).
  • Knowledge of agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).


Key Competencies

  • Project Planning & Execution
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Problem Solving
  • Organization & Prioritization
  • Results Orientation
  • Adaptability

title: Analista de Negócios e Inovação Junior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Negócios e Inovação Junior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

Garantir a excelência no atendimento técnico e consultivo às seguradoras, atuando como o elo principal entre as necessidades do cliente e a entrega da solução. O desafio desta posição é realizar uma gestão \"ponta a ponta\" (end-to-end), combinando visão técnica para testes de sistema com uma postura de Sucesso do Cliente (CS) de nível 2. Os principais desafios são:

  • Compreender demandas complexas de seguradoras e traduzi-las em soluções técnicas;
  • Realizar testes precisos para garantir que as entregas atendam aos requisitos solicitados;
  • Atuar com autonomia e agilidade como suporte de segunda camada;
  • Manter um relacionamento de confiança e alta qualidade com parceiros corporativos;
  • Gerenciar múltiplas solicitações simultâneas com foco em resolução e prazo.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Atender demandas críticas de seguradoras, realizando a análise inicial e o acompanhamento até a resolução final;
  • Realizar testes técnicos em sistemas para validar funcionalidades e comportamentos esperados;
  • Conduzir reuniões e chamadas de vídeo com clientes para alinhamento de expectativas e apresentações de soluções;
  • Redigir e-mails profissionais e técnicos, mantendo o cliente sempre posicionado sobre o status das demandas;
  • Atuar como Nível 2 de suporte, resolvendo problemas que exigem maior profundidade técnica e análise de processos;
  • Apoiar na melhoria contínua dos sistemas e fluxos de atendimento com base no feedback dos clientes.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

  • Ensino superior (em andamento ou completo);
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita (essencial para contato direto com seguradoras);
  • Postura profissional e habilidade para realizar apresentações e reuniões online;
  • Conhecimento básico de informática e ferramentas de produtividade (E-mail, Pacote Office, Google Workspace);
  • Perfil organizado, com facilidade para aprender novos processos e sistemas rapidamente;
  • Proatividade e foco genuíno na resolução de problemas.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:

  • Conhecimento prévio sobre o mercado de seguros;
  • Experiência com atendimento B2B (Business to Business);
  • Vivência com ferramentas de chamados e gestão de demandas (Jira, Movidesk ou similares);
  • Noções básicas de tecnologia (ex.: entender estrutura de JSON, curiosidade para testar endpoints/APIs).


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

Plano de Saúde

title: Analista de QA (Automação)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de QA (Automação) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos:

A Prezensa é uma consultoria de outsourcing de tecnologia com mais de uma década de mercado e um modelo que faz diferente: o People Tech.

Somos a primeira People Tech do Brasil porque acreditamos que tecnologia de verdade só é feita por gente que se sente valorizada, desafiada e apoiada. Aqui, os profissionais atuam como copilotos, presentes nas decisões que importam, assumindo responsabilidade real do começo ao fim.

Cada profissional é acompanhado, cada cliente é ouvido e cada entrega tem propósito. Pessoas são nossa força motriz, atenção na pista é inegociável e resultado é a nossa linha de chegada.

Quer sentar no banco da frente? Seu caminho é na Prezensa.

Requisito da vaga


Hard Skills:

  • Experiência em Robot Framework para automação de testes funcionais e de aceitação;
  • Cypress para testes end-to-end em aplicações web modernas;
  • Python para desenvolvimento de scripts, bibliotecas de suporte e integração com frameworks de teste;
  • Inteligência Artificial com algoritmos de machine learning aplicados à análise de logs, geração de dados de teste e detecção de anomalias;
  • CI/CD, com Jenkins, GitHub Actions e GitLab CI para execução automatizada de pipelines;
  • Controle de versão com Git e GitFlow para gerenciamento de código de automação;
  • Experiência em monitoramento.


Soft Skills:

  • Trabalho em equipe;
  • Proatividade;
  • Dinamismo;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal e com cliente;
  • Senso de urgência;
  • Objetividade e clareza na exposição de ideias para o time;
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita.


O que nós oferecemos

  • Incentivo educacional para impulsionar seu desenvolvimento;
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos e instituições renomadas (FIAP, FGV, EBAC, Impacta, Full Cycle, Conecte, Open English, Cellep e mais);
  • Wellhub: acesso a soluções completas de saúde e bem-estar;
  • Onhappy: plataforma com descontos em viagens e experiências.

title: Veterinarian
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Veterinarian em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Veterinary Analyst (PJ Contractor)


Join SignalPET as a Junior Veterinary Analyst and Shape the Future of Veterinary Radiology!


At SignalPET, we’re transforming the veterinary industry with cutting-edge radiograph interpretation technology. Our mission? To elevate veterinary care through advanced, accessible, and highly accurate radiographic insights. Committed to innovation and excellence, we’re making a meaningful impact on the veterinary profession worldwide.


As we rapidly expand, we’re excited to invite Junior Veterinary Analysts who are driven, qualified, and passionate about companion animal radiology to join our dynamic team.

Why SignalPET?


Innovative Environment: Be part of a pioneering tech company in its hyper-growth stage.

Career Advancement: Grow with us while advancing your expertise in veterinary radiology.

Work-Life Balance: Enjoy a flexible remote working environment with competitive compensation.

Impactful Work: Make a difference by assisting in the development of AI technology that’s shaping the future of veterinary care.


What We’re Looking For:

  • A qualified Médico Veterinário.
  • Clinical experience (an advantage), with a strong interest in radiology.
  • A Brazilian citizen or holder of a valid Brazilian work permit.
  • Ability to work as an independent contractor (PJ).


Role & Responsibilities:

  • Screen routine radiographic studies.
  • Assist in the development and improvement of our AI technology.


What You’ll Bring:

  • Sharp analytical skills and meticulous attention to detail.
  • A disciplined, motivated, and ethical approach to work.
  • Strong time management skills and the ability to follow detailed instructions.


Shift Details:

We have 2 positions available and the shifts are as follows:


Monday to Sunday, from 2:00 PM to 12:00 AM São Paulo time, one week on and one week off.


Example Schedule:

  • Week 1: Monday to Sunday ON
  • Week 2: Monday to Sunday OFF
  • Week 3: Monday to Sunday ON
  • Week 4: Monday to Sunday OFF


Contract Type:


Independent Contractor (PJ – Pessoa Jurídica)

This is a contractor position and not an employment relationship. Candidates must be able to invoice SignalPET through their own registered Brazilian legal entity (Pessoa Jurídica).


Location:

Remote


Training:

Full training provided.


Excited to Elevate Your Career with SignalPET?

Apply today to join a team where your work directly contributes to the advancement of veterinary science and technology.


Please provide your resume in English, if possible.

title: Subject Matter Expert - Finance
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Subject Matter Expert - Finance em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We’re hiring finance professionals who know AP, AR, accounting close, or finance systems inside-out — and want to help shape how AI understands finance workflows.

In this role, you’ll use your real-world experience with QuickBooks, Bill.com, and Concur to create realistic finance scenarios, evaluate AI outputs, and improve the accuracy of next-generation AI systems.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Create finance workflow prompts and real-world accounting scenarios
  • Review and evaluate AI-generated responses for accuracy and reasoning
  • Build synthetic invoices, bills, reconciliations, and GL datasets
  • Identify edge cases such as duplicate bills, sync failures, policy violations, and GAAP errors
  • Help improve AI performance across finance operations and controls


We're looking for:

Professionals with hands-on experience in one or more of the following:

  • Accounts Payable
  • Accounts Receivable
  • Accounting & Month-End Close
  • Controller / Finance Management
  • Finance Systems Administration


Requirements:

  • 4–12 years of finance/accounting experience
  • Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks, Bill.com, and/or Concur
  • Understanding of US GAAP and finance controls
  • Excellent written communication skills
  • Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude
  • CPA/CMA preferred (required for Controller-level roles)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with AI evaluation, RLHF, or LLM projects
  • ERP migrations, multi-entity or multi-currency exposure
  • Basic Python or SQL skills


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Work at the intersection of Finance + AI
  • Influence how AI systems reason about accounting workflows


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week)

title: Pessoa Analista de Desenvolvimento Pleno - Claude Code
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Analista de Desenvolvimento Pleno - Claude Code em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Venha fazer parte de um time inovador como como Pessoa Analista de Desenvolvimento Pleno - Claude Code , dentro de um ambiente que valoriza espírito empreendedor, autonomia, agilidade, foco no cliente, excelência e visão de longo prazo e inconformismo, num projeto de PIX, garantindo a segurança e eficiência das operações financeiras.

title: Senior Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Azure DevOps Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Summary:

  • We are seeking a highly skilled and creative Senior Azure DevOps Engineer to provide technical leadership and drive the evolution of our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines. In this role, you will not only manage progress on critical projects and provide high-level support, but you will also serve as the technical anchor for our DevOps practices.
  • The ideal candidate blends deep technical proficiency in the Microsoft Azure ecosystem with the creative problem-solving skills required to build elegant, scalable, and secure automation frameworks.


Location: 40% Remote and 60% onsite in São Paulo, Brazil (Paraiso district) - onsite 1 week every 2-3 weeks


Responsibilities:

  • Technical Leadership: Serve as the subject matter expert on Azure DevOps practices, guiding project architecture and mentoring team members without the burden of administrative people-management.
  • Project Delivery & Support: Ensure steady, measurable progress on core engineering projects while providing robust tier-3 infrastructure and pipeline support.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Design, build, and maintain modular, multi-environment (Dev/Test/Prod) infrastructure using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates, ensuring strict adherence to state and drift management best practices.
  • CI/CD Automation: Design and optimize sophisticated, multi-stage YAML-based Azure DevOps pipelines to automate infrastructure and application deployments for multi-language stacks (.NET, Python, Node.js, Java).
  • DevSecOps Implementation: Integrate robust security gates, vulnerability scanners, and compliance checks directly into the CI/CD lifecycle.


Experience:

Technical Requirements

Azure Platform Expertise

  • IaC Tools: Proven experience with Terraform (utilizing remote state on Azure Storage), Bicep, or ARM.
  • Azure DevOps Services: Deep familiarity with the full ADO suite (Repos, Pipelines, Boards, Artifacts).
  • Scripting & Management: Proficiency with Azure CLI, PowerShell (Az module), and REST APIs.
  • Observability: Hands-on experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
  • Governance & Security: Strong grasp of Azure Policy, Blueprints, RBAC, and Azure Key Vault for secret/certificate management.
  • Containers & Serverless: Foundational knowledge of Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Helm, Azure Container Registry (ACR), Azure Functions, and App Services.


CI/CD & Deployment Strategies

  • Mastery of multi-stage YAML pipelines in Azure DevOps (GitHub Actions is a strong plus).
  • Proven track record implementing advanced deployment strategies (Blue-Green, Canary, Rolling).
  • Experience integrating security scanning tools such as SonarQube, WhiteSource, or Snyk into automated pipelines.


Security & Enterprise Compliance

  • Comprehensive understanding of Secure DevOps practices and automated security gates (SCA, IaC scans).
  • Experience with Azure Active Directory (AAD) integration and MFA policies.
  • Familiarity with Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, and enterprise security baselines is highly desirable.


What Will Make You Successful

  • Technical Proficiency: You have a battle-tested understanding of enterprise Azure environments and CI/CD mechanics. You don't just use tools; you know how they work under the hood.
  • Creativity: You look beyond standard templates to find innovative ways to optimize workflows, solve complex deployment bottlenecks, and design elegant technical solutions.
  • Drive for Progress: You are self-motivated to push projects across the finish line while maintaining high-quality support standards.

title: Senior Creative Director
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Creative Director em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Creative Director

Talent Global LLC — Remote

Part-Time (10 hrs/week) | US Time Zones | Long-Term Contract


About the Role

Our client is a US-based performance marketing agency that builds and scales creative content for brands across paid social and digital channels. They are looking for a Creative Director to serve as the internal quality gate for all creative output — both video and graphics — before it reaches the client. This person will work closely with the agency's leadership team, taking ownership of creative review, direction, and strategy across active accounts.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review and QA all video and graphic creative assets before client delivery, ensuring quality, brand alignment, and strategic clarity
  • Provide clear, actionable creative direction to designers and video editors based on client briefs and performance goals
  • Develop creative strategies for new content batches — defining concept, visual direction, messaging angle, and format
  • Identify creative weaknesses across active accounts and propose improvements proactively
  • Maintain a high creative bar across all output, with strong attention to detail in both visual execution and storytelling


Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Creative Director, Senior Art Director, or equivalent role at a marketing agency or performance-focused creative team
  • Strong portfolio spanning both video and graphic content — social ads, brand content, or performance creative
  • Ability to both review/direct existing work and develop new creative strategies from scratch
  • Deep understanding of what makes creative perform on paid social channels (Meta, TikTok, YouTube)
  • Experience working with or managing designers and video editors
  • Excellent written and verbal English — able to communicate creative feedback clearly and professionally
  • Self-directed and highly detail-oriented — comfortable working async with a lean team
  • Familiarity with AI creative tools (Midjourney, Runway, or similar) is a plus


Ideal Candidate

This role is for someone who has a natural eye for what's working and what isn't — and can articulate why with precision. They thrive in fast-moving agency environments where standards are high and feedback cycles are tight. They are equally comfortable directing a video edit and reviewing a static ad set, and they understand that creative strategy and execution are inseparable. They don't need to be reminded to raise the bar — they set it.

description:

# SQLAlchemy, Python expert (remote, freelance)


## Company description


FairSplit.com , a small American company, helps families navigate estate, downsizing, death, or divorce by providing a web app for building inventories and then dividing assets among beneficiaries. FairSplit offers unique division methods such as Emotional Value rounds, promoting transparency, fairness and impartiality. This tool can be used by professionals assisting families or directly by family members.


Our motto is \"Divide things, not families\". The best thing about working for FairSplit is the certainty that we are making the world better, by helping people in rare, delicate moments of their lives .


## Role description


This is a **remote, freelance role for a senior backend Python developer**. You will work with other members of an agile team to write server-side logic and integrate front-end elements.


No agencies, please. Only individuals.


Payment is per hour worked. Hourly value dependent on your demonstrable experience. All work is remote.


This is a ~3-month-long position with a good chance of extending further.


## Technologies involved


- the Python language, with typing annotations

- SQLAlchemy (the Python ORM)

- the Starlette web framework (basis of FastAPI)

- the Pyramid web framework (legacy for us)

- git


## Requisites


- Fluent English.

- Committed to working 40h per week .

- Experience with back-end development and database design.

- Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and web services.

- Deep knowledge about security and scalability of web apps.

- Interest in the themes of software architecture, open source and agile.

- Interest in pair programming.

- Attention to detail and precision in the use of language.

- Good communication: you don't disappear, you don't shun video calls, you are present in our Discord group while working, you ask for help when needed, you write on kanban cards to provide insight into your work and you spontaneously provide advice when you see the opportunity.

- Willing to sign an NDA.


Please share any public repositories (github etc.).

Job Title: AI Visual Storytelling Designer/AI Creative Producer

Our client company (a US-based Creative Agency) is looking for 2–3 highly creative AI-native talents who can combine generative AI, motion design, video editing, and visual storytelling to create modern, high-performing social content for brands and ventures.


This is not a traditional graphic design or video editing role. We are looking for creatives who deeply understand internet aesthetics, AI-powered workflows, cinematic social visuals, and short-form content that captures attention immediately.

  • Stay up to date with AI creative trends, social content trends, and emerging tools

  • Strong portfolio showcasing AI-generated visuals, motion graphics, or cinematic social content
  • Experience creating modern social-first creative content for startups, agencies, brands, or creators
  • Strong understanding of visual storytelling, pacing, composition, typography, and internet culture
  • Ability to combine creativity with execution speed
  • Self-directed, proactive, and highly collaborative
  • Strong aesthetic taste and attention to detail

We are seeking a \"IT Support Engineer \" for our client, a top service provider renowned for trading and refurbishing used technology, such as cellphones and laptops. This company is dedicated to assisting manufacturers with sustainable practices and plays a significant role in reducing new tech expenses on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


• To provide operational support across Alchemy’s estate of devices, network infrastructure,

and end user computing related cloud services including health checks and reporting.

• Diagnose and resolve faults in physical and cloud-based services and infrastructure supported

by the Technical Operations team

• Take ownership of configuring and maintaining Alchemy’s Physical and virtual network

infrastructure, including LAN, WAN and Telephony

• Maintain the Security integrity of the Technical Operations service portfolio including

patching, automated vulnerability assessments, Firewalls, software Security suites and MDM

• Proactively educate Alchemists, instilling a security first mindset through the use of our

automated phishing and exploit awareness toolsets

• Support Alchemists in become as self-sufficient as possible by providing self-service tools, and

creating knowledge base articles to improve incident and event resolution efficiency

• Managing incidents, problems, requests and changes in line with ITIL best practice and

ensuring that SLA's are maintained

• Act as a cross-media Point of Resolution for all Support Engineering related issues

• Analyse and measure your services to develop, communicate and action continual process and

technology improvements

• Work without continuous supervision and be trusted to provide professional support services

to your fellow Alchemists

• Provide proactive monitoring and management of Technical Operations services to your fellow

Alchemists

• Guide Alchemy in your personal development and self-educate to attain industry standard IT

accreditations

• Manage, respond to and resolve all End User based incidents and events

• Install, configure and manage End User Devices and Applications

• Work to proactively prevent Security threats to your service portfolio, End User Devices and

Applications. Should any occur, immediately respond effectively to and contain those IT

Security threats and incidents

• Maintaining agreed SLA levels and assure quality of delivery at all times

• Ordering and installation of hardware as required

• Delivery of project-related tasks

• Creation of relevant technical diagrams and documentation

• Ensure that your estate and environments adhere to established standards and frameworks,

meeting any compliance requirements at all times.

• Input into the design and implementation of new platforms, services and infrastructure

including the creation of associated documentation

• Completing internal moves and changes as required

• Setting up new sites and locations as required

• Ensure all logs for equipment and users are maintained

• Providing support to Alcehmists whether remotely or in person

• Keeping up to date with industry trends and technology developments

• Identifying and sharing relevant architectural patterns

• Contributing towards creating a culture of metrics and data to drive continuous improvement

• Working closely with Infosec to ensure Security ‘shifts left’

• Collaborating gclosely with the Engineering teams, promoting a DevOps culture


Your Behaviors:

• Communicator – You can make yourself concisely and clearly understood through positive

interactions with people across all levels of Alchemy regardless of their seniority, geography

and culture

• People Focused – You understand that people make Alchemy a success

• Problem Solver – You love to fix things

• Lifelong Learner – Everyday is a chance to discover/teach something new

• Creative – You are a fountain of innovative ideas and love experimenting

• Logical – You look for facts and think your way to a conclusion

• Forward looking – You embrace new and better ways of doing things, and relish the

opportunity to take others on the journey with you

• Confident – You embrace having positive, open and candid discussions with individuals at all

levels

• Diplomatic – The message is always delivered with consideration of others needs

• Decisive – you have a keen sense of prioritisation and make intelligent decisions

independently

• Motivated – You are a self-starter with a ‘can-do’ attitude and the ability to work

independently under light supervision

• Reliable - You’re the person stakeholders and peers always want to work with, remaining

visible as the face of IT to listen to concerns and share as needed

• Professional – It’s never personal, you understand what is happening from the end users

perspective

• Presentable – You don’t need suits and ties to inspire confidence, we do so through our

smart casual appearance

• Compassionate – You understand that people in need require careful attention

• Energetic - You bring bags of energy every day, the only way is forward

• Organised - You are detail oriented and manage your time and the time of others well

• Data driven – Information is your friend; you love to use facts and evidence to help ensure

School of the Nations is an authorized International Baccalaureate (IB) School offering the Primary Years (PYP) and the Diploma (DP) Programs. Accredited as an international school by NEASC, our strategic development is guided by the ACE Learning Ecosystem 2.0.


Shared Understanding of High-Quality Learning

High-quality learning at the School of the Nations is rooted in our aspiration to release human potential through academic excellence, moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service, empowering learners to develop the capacities of heart and mind to understand the world and contribute to the betterment of society.


In an inclusive, diverse, and globally-minded community, our students develop cognitive, creative, physical, spiritual, and social-emotional abilities; learners are agents of their own learning, actively setting goals, engaging in rich and complex challenges, and documenting growth; they demonstrate depth of understanding, collaboration, reflection, and multiple perspectives across disciplines.


Learning happens through a coherent, inquiry-based curriculum grounded in spiritual principles and practical applications, with diverse assessment and feedback guiding meaningful growth.


School of the Nations is an equal-opportunity employer. We encourage people with disability to apply.
